about: The closed registry of testing modules (docs/modules.md). The only keys `modules.sh set` may write, with their only values; read by preflight.sh, catalog.mjs and verify-onboarding.sh. A module with `due` is due by something else than the candidate (`pr`: a labelled pull request; `signals`: real-user data, `ux-signals.mjs check`): the pre-flight asks its own script, never `modules.sh due`.

modules.title: Issue criteria
modules.what: Freezes each labelled issue's acceptance criteria and checks them red-green against the last release.

modules.title: Edge cases
modules.what: Checks beyond each criterion: invalid input, persistence, roles, idempotence, boundaries. Never a verdict.

modules.title: Nightly regression
modules.what: Replays the promoted tests on every new build, aware of what changed.

modules.title: Security checks
modules.what: Black-box OWASP checks of the nested product. Findings stay in a private report.

modules.title: Scenario discovery
modules.what: Proposes user flows nobody asked for yet, and tests them when allowed.

modules.title: Benchmark
modules.what: Scores this agent's own verdicts on cases with a known answer.

modules.title: Change radar
modules.what: Reads the titles and descriptions of pull requests and proposes a review of the recurring tests that a change can affect.

modules.title: Audit
modules.what: Weekly health check of the agent: schedules, logs, costs, the suite.

modules.title: UI sweep
modules.what: Walks every mapped page at several screen sizes and finds layout, visual and accessibility defects for design.

modules.title: Form validation
modules.what: Fills every mapped form with empty, too long, wrong-type, unicode and duplicate input.

modules.title: Stress
modules.what: Bounded concurrent load on the local product: errors, slowdowns, and whether it stays up.

modules.title: Inconsistency radar
modules.what: Walks the main screens and finds patterns that look different for the same job: page headers, margins, buttons, empty states.

modules.title: PR design check
modules.what: Checks the screens that a labelled pull request changes, on the first main build after its merge (or its own build): missing states, accessibility in light and dark, design tokens, retired words.

modules.title: Real-user UX signals
modules.what: Reads how real users fare in the UI, replays the worst signals on the build they ran, and turns confirmed ones into design findings for Design Desk.

modules.title: Feature focus
modules.what: Tests one area of the product in depth, once, on request.
